rows.note: Use 冇味 as the all-purpose colloquial choice for food or drink that lacks flavour.
Use 淡 when food or drink tastes weak or insufficiently seasoned rather than completely flavourless.

example.english: This soup is tasteless and needs more salt.
example.jyutping: ni1 bou1 tong1 taam5 zo2 di1 jiu3 gaa1 jim4

rows.note: Use 淡茂茂 as an emphatic colloquial description of something conspicuously bland.

example.traditional: 呢碗粥淡茂茂，完全唔夠味。
example.jyutping: ni1 wun2 zuk1 taam5 mau6 mau6 jyun4 cyun4 m4 gau3 mei6

rows.note: Use 冇品味 for a person, design, or choice that lacks refinement or good taste.

example.english: They are wearing designer labels from head to toe, but the outfit is tasteless.
example.traditional: 佢成身名牌，但係個配搭真係冇品味。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 san1 meng2 paai4 daan6 hai6 go3 pui3 daap3 zan1 hai6 mou5 ban2 mei6
